g.text: GO annotation of consistent, effect-selected fibroblast genes
Circles: alveolar-up; triangles: adventitial-up; area scales with overlap count. Top five terms per direction/cohort; related GO terms overlap.
Foreground: |mean paired difference| ≥1, same sign in 2/2 source or ≥3/4 external donors. Background: 11,113 expressed genes.
BH correction covers all eligible terms and both directions within cohort. This is annotation enrichment, not a DE-gene significance test.
